csv_project_name: P3 for Historic Bathhouse Facility Renovation
csv_agency: LA Dept of Culture Recreation Tourism
csv_scope_of_work: The Louisiana Department of Culture, Recreation and Tourism (DCRT) invites interested parties to submit proposals to renovate, redevelop, and operate an existing historic bathhouse facility located within Fontainebleau State Park (Project). The Project s objective is to transform the current 4,000-square foot, lakefront structure (Bathhouse) into an updated, functional, and revenue-generating facility that enhances visitor experience and supports long-term park operations. he selected proposer (Contractor) will be responsible for providing all design, construction, project management, and related services necessary to renovate the existing Bathhouse and convert it into a revenue-producing venue and to manage and operate that venue under a revenue-sharing agreement with the DCRT.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management

title: P3 for Historic Bathhouse Facility Renovation
short_description: Renovation and redevelopment of a historic 4,000-square-foot bathhouse into a revenue-generating venue.
project_location: Fontainebleau State Park, 62883 LA-1089, Mandeville, Louisiana 70448, USA
project_scope: Renovation, redevelopment, and operation of an existing historic 4,000-square-foot lakefront bathhouse facility within Fontainebleau State Park. The selected contractor is to transform the existing structure into an updated, functional, revenue-generating venue and provide all required design, construction, project management, and related services under a revenue-sharing agreement.
services: Design-build/developer services; rehabilitation and refurbishment; construction; project management; operation of the renovated venue.
relevance_explanation:
- Small building project with about 4,000 square feet only.
- Primarily a renovation and operational P3 opportunity, not a structurally ambitious bridge or special structure.
- Includes design and construction scope, but no indication of complex structural engineering or long-span elements.
- Historic refurbishment may require careful intervention, yet the tender focus is broader development/operation rather than specialist structural design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available cost-related information: historic bathhouse renovation, approximately 4,000 square feet, lakefront location, design-build/developer P3 model with operation under a revenue-sharing agreement. A realistic cost estimate is not possible from the provided information alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The procurement is a P3-style design-build/developer and operations contract, so a distinct engineering fee for sbp cannot be derived from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Interested parties are invited to submit proposals to renovate, redevelop, and operate the facility. Requested disciplines include design-build/developer, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and construction/project management. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.

notes: Project stage: RFP/RFQ. Contract duration: base period 120 with renewal option 120; renewable: yes. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-05-12 10:00 AM CDT at the Bathhouse, attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-05-26 05:00 PM CDT. The source describes a revenue-sharing agreement and ongoing operation responsibility in addition to renovation.
